title: betterlite on GCP (Cloud Run)
name: betterlite-gcp
description: Deploys the betterlite proxy on GCP: a Cloud Run service behind an external load balancer, Cloud SQL with a read replica, Memorystore Redis, two GCS buckets, Secret Manager entries and a Cloud Run migration job. Takes about 20 minutes on the first apply.

custom_settings.name: image
custom_settings.description: Container image holding betterlite and betterlite-db-admin, from a registry Cloud Run can pull: Artifact Registry, gcr.io or Docker Hub. Format: <region>-docker.pkg.dev/<project>/<repo>/betterlite:<tag>

custom_settings.name: litellm_master_key
custom_settings.description: Master key betterlite accepts as LITELLM_MASTER_KEY. Enter a secret of your own (an sk-... string); it is written to terraform.tfvars, so delete that file when you are done with it
